law.catch_line: (For contingent effective date, see Acts 2025, cc. 91 and 109, cl. 2) Virginia coordinate systems designated
law.text: The systems of plane coordinates that have been established by the National Ocean Service/National Geodetic Survey or its successors for defining and stating the positions or locations of points on the surface of the earth within the Commonwealth are to be known and designated as the "Virginia Coordinate System of 1927," the "Virginia Coordinate System of 1983," and the "Virginia Coordinate System of 2022."
